core_meaning.primary_meaning: Sohrab is a Persian-origin name meaning “Persian legendary hero”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Sohrab corresponds to the Persian form سُهْرَاب (Persian سهراب (Sohrāb)). Its core sense is sohrab; a persian legendary hero. Sohrab is Persian سهراب (Sohrāb), the name of a hero in the Shahnameh. It is used as a male given name in Iran.
